trigger: an OLD-version server binary started against the v8 schema (rollback, or an old replica left running); the migration runner has no newer-schema guard
classification_rationale: the old refresh INSERT omits grain (NOT NULL, no default) so every old refresh rolls back and never heals; the old grain-less read lists each title once per grain row
summary: v8 made grain NOT NULL with no default, so an older binary against v8 never refreshes and lists duplicated titles (architect A-1, docs-writer F2, compliance F-1, enterprise F2 corroborate as documentation).

trigger: an operator reads the gauge/alert guidance on a fleet whose refresh passes 60 s, or whose first refresh after v8 fails
classification_rationale: the gauge is whole-refresh wall-clock, 60 s is a per-statement constant, the whole-refresh budget is 600 s, neither is a flag; keep-last-good is false for the first refresh after v8
summary: "approaching the 60s budget ... raise the budget" is false (docs-writer F1, consistency F1, happy F2, sre F2, enterprise F1, unhappy UP-2); same wording in docs/prometheus/yuzu-alerts.yml (outside this diff) and software_inventory_store.cpp:51-62.

trigger: an old replica is running while v8 applies, or an operator rolls back after v8
classification_rationale: doc basis: routed-concern ladder obligation (category 6): lock behaviour (DROP queues behind an old replica refresh, dies at the 10 s lock_timeout) and rollback posture are not recorded
summary: The v8 ladder row and the operator upgrade text omit lock behaviour, the post-upgrade "building" window and the rollback/mixed-version posture (architect A-1, docs-writer F2, compliance F-1, enterprise F2).

trigger: a fleet above ~6,000 endpoints (~2.7M installed rows at ~450 titles each): the GROUPING SETS statement hits the flat 60 s per-statement cap
classification_rationale: measured on local PG 18.6: GROUPING SETS 12.8x the old catalogue GROUP BY (37 s vs 2.9 s at 1.8M rows), whole refresh ~6.5x; ceiling was ~47k endpoints before; v8 drops last-good so the catalogue stays building; the manual said ~4x and gave no ceiling
summary: Pilot-sized by design (roadmap Disposition 7) but the ceiling and the real cost multiple were not stated in any repo text (performance F1/F2, architect A-2, enterprise F1).

trigger: the same fleet size; the refresh can only complete below the ceiling
classification_rationale: the per-statement timeout cannot be derived from the remaining budget without a mid-statement cancel (libpq is never cancelled; the flat 60 s bounds the shutdown-join stall and systemd TimeoutStopSec=210)
summary: Making the rollup incremental and/or cancellable mid-statement is the real fix for the ceiling; declined for this PR by the Architect with evidence.

trigger: the database role lacks TEMPORARY privilege (hardened Postgres)
classification_rationale: first server store to need CREATE TEMP TABLE; 42501 on every refresh leaves the catalogue building forever; no manual or ladder prerequisite named it
summary: CREATE TEMP TABLE newest_tmp is a new role prerequisite with no operator text (unhappy-path UP-3, security-guardian note).

trigger: an operator reads the changelog; the catalogue search now also matches ecosystem and source though the table shows neither
classification_rationale: doc basis: changelog fragment for an operator-visible change (category 3)
summary: The fragment omitted the search broadening and the counter change, overclaimed "computes the page KPIs", and said "first hourly refresh" (it runs at boot).

trigger: a maintainer trusts a comment that no longer matches the code
classification_rationale: hpp:352 invents a boot-time non-cancellable caller (also adversarial K-1/CX-1); store.cpp hold comment; test comment v4 vs v8; rules.hpp NVD "restated"/"ONE divergence" claim; default limit 100 undocumented
summary: Five stale or inaccurate comments introduced by this change.

trigger: a refactor returns an engaged empty vector when a rewritten read fails
classification_rationale: ADR-0016 section 7: an empty page must never mean failure; no failure-arm test existed for software_catalog, software_versions or catalog_rollup_meta
summary: The degrade-to-nullopt contract of the rewritten reads was untested.

trigger: selecting a case by name or the flake-retry isolated retry
classification_rationale: Catch2 splits a name filter at the comma so by-name selection matches zero tests
summary: Two new test names contained commas.

trigger: a q with an invalid UTF-8 byte, or more than 128 leading continuation bytes
classification_rationale: PG rejects the bound text (22021) so a healthy store reads as degraded; an all-continuation prefix clamps to empty and runs unfiltered
summary: Search-term hygiene gap (security-guardian F-1, unhappy UP-7); newly reachable on the raw and host reads once PR-2 wires q.

classification_rationale: every failure looks identical at the worker generic warn, which is exactly what building-forever needs diagnosing; cancel and budget exhaustion share one info line
summary: The refresh does not log why a statement failed (sre F4, unhappy UP-4).

classification_rationale: count(DISTINCT publisher) sorts every row: 3.4 s vs 0.21 s at 1.8M rows
summary: Publisher KPI sorts the whole table.

classification_rationale: four bind() calls in one operator+ chain are unsequenced so the $n text order differs per compiler; numbering stays correct
summary: Unsequenced bind() calls in one expression.

trigger: persistent refresh failure on the hourly cadence
classification_rationale: sum(rate(...{outcome="error"}[15m])) > 0 with for: 15m cannot be satisfied by a counter that increments once an hour; lazily created, no 0-seed
summary: YuzuInventoryCatalogRollupFailing cannot fire for the failure it covers; newly load-bearing because v8 makes building a guaranteed post-upgrade state.

classification_rationale: dormant code with no caller in this PR: host view returns a fleet-derived newest_version (omit for confined callers or accept under the ADR-0017 gap); agent_ids unbounded; cursor should be opaque and bound to filters and refresh generation; empty-string dimension filters unselectable; SoftwareCatalogRow omits stored sources; rows and KPIs read in separate snapshots; PR-2 audit rows/verbs, service-scoped-token deny, A4/A5 annotations and retry_after_ms for the 5 s nullopt, authorize_list_read for host views; the page hint/placeholder strings
